# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform alignment and interop reliability**

## Highlights

Upcoming 4.156 changes improve callback reliability and platform integrations while raising Apple and Uno requirements. Includes Linux HarfBuzz coexistence fixes, display-paced Android texture rendering, corrected Unicode helpers, and lower-allocation pixel and text paths. These changes landed after Preview 1.

## Breaking Changes

- **Respect Apple minimums at every layer** — Native SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now require macOS 11 and iOS/tvOS/Mac Catalyst 14. Managed iOS/tvOS minimums rise to 14; managed macOS 12 and Mac Catalyst 15 requirements remain higher and unchanged. Raise application deployment targets as needed; the lower native baseline does not permit lowering managed or framework minimums. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **Migrate Uno views to Uno 7 and .NET 10** — Non-Windows Uno views now require Uno 7/.NET 10, replacing per-platform runtime packages and pre-Uno 7 WasmShell integration. SKSwapChainPanel derives from Grid, uses a CPU canvas, reports null GRContext, and removes RaiseOnUnsupported; use SKCanvasElement for GPU rendering. DrawInBackground remains unsupported. Windows facades retain the ANGLE-backed control; Uno.Sdk supplies platform native assets. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Keep SKData copy lengths within the source array** — SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) now throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the requested length exceeds the array. Pass a length within the source buffer rather than relying on an out-of-bounds native read. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Pass one encoded unit to the character-code helper** — StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode now validates encoded byte width: use ASCII for Utf8, a single BMP unit for Utf16, or one Unicode scalar for Utf32. Multi-unit inputs are rejected rather than truncated or failing inside BitConverter. GetString(null, encoding) now throws ArgumentNullException instead of NullReferenceException; update exception handling if needed. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native boolean callback widths** — Corrects Skia callbacks to one-byte native booleans and HarfBuzz hb_bool_t callbacks to four-byte integers, addressing ARM64 interpreter return handling and false-returning font/Unicode callbacks. Public managed APIs and delegates retain bool signatures. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **HarfBuzz coexists with Linux GTK** — Binds internal calls to the bundled HarfBuzz functions so globally loaded system HarfBuzz cannot redirect them and mix incompatible private objects. Applies to the common Linux link recipe, including Linux NoDependencies. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **Android automatic frames follow display refresh** — Texture-backed continuous rendering, including MAUI Android SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, uses Choreographer instead of unbounded buffer-swap throughput. Drawing stays on the GL worker; explicit requests and lifecycle progress remain independent of display callbacks. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Unicode codes and native strings** — Decodes valid single-unit character codes at the requested encoding width and guards null byte arrays before reading Length. Also fixes the native C-string buffer over-read. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506), [#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Shader validation** — Rejects overflowing SkSL raster-pipeline slot counts and invalid runtime-effect types earlier. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489))
- **GLES upload compatibility** — Ganesh GL no longer advertises unsupported BGRA8-as-RGBx uploads on GLES; readback is unchanged. ([#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))
- **WebGPU C++ support ships in the archive** — Includes emdawnwebgpu C++ support inside libSkiaSharp.a, avoiding C++ flags on application C sources. JavaScript glue remains link input rather than deployed content. Custom GPU-disabled or pre-change archives do not satisfy the newer link contract. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Borrowed stream references released on disposal** — Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream clears its reference to a wrapped stream even when disposeUnderlyingStream is false. It does not dispose that borrowed stream; the caller retains disposal responsibility. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Lower-allocation image and shaping paths** — Managed pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData when direct copying is valid. HarfBuzz UTF-32 string additions pool their encoding buffer, and feature formatting avoids native allocation while preserving decoding semantics. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Windows native and library alignment** — Updates ANGLE to chromium/8118 and aligns Windows library dependencies with Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003. Native source builds move to VS 2026/MSVC v145; these updates do not themselves raise the declared Windows runtime minimum. ([#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390))
